description: One-shot quotes across any service. Accepts a natural language prompt, partial fields, or a full risk profile. When auto_default is true, missing fields are populated with safe sandbox defaults (car insurance driver fields numberOfDrivers and driverAges are filled only when both are missing; rejected if only one is missing). Pass grant_token for Protected Mode. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

inputSchema.description: One-shot quote request: a plain-language prompt, and/or service_id plus any of that service's fields. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

auto_default.description: Set true to fill missing fields with safe sandbox defaults. Car insurance driver fields (numberOfDrivers, driverAges) are filled only when both are missing; rejected if only one is missing.

grant_token.description: Optional grant token for Protected Mode

prompt.description: Plain-language request, e.g. 'car insurance for a 2019 Honda Civic in Austin TX 78701'. No names or ID numbers.

risk_profile.description: Optional: the service's fields as key/value pairs (see moltbound_requirements). They may also be passed at the top level.

service_id.description: Which of the 20 US services to quote, e.g. car_insurance, home_building, dog_pet_insurance, travel, electricity.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: moltbound_quick_quote
